items.text:
Sol.306.(c) Common - characterised by a lack of privilege or special status. Noble - belonging to a high social rank in a society, especially by birth. Magical -  relating  to  magic  or  having extraordinary qualities. Grand - impressive in size or appearance. Indescribable - too unusual or extreme to be described.
Sol.307.(c)  Mild  gentle  in  nature  or behavior. Vehement showing strong and intense feeling. Reliable -consistently  dependable  or trustworthy. Passionate  having  strong  emotions or enthusiasm. Smashed broken into pieces or severely damaged.
Sol.308.(c) Permanent -lasting or intended to last indefinitely. Transient lasting only for a short time. Transparent -allowing light to pass through  so  that  objects  behind  can  be seen clearly. Transitory temporary. Irregular  not  consistent  or  uniform  in shape or pattern.
Sol.309.(d) Guilty -  responsible  for  a specified wrongdoing. Innocent - free from guilt or blame. Unfair - not just or equitable. Mischievous - causing or showing a fondness for trouble in a playful way. Righteous - morally right and virtuous.
